title: Chapter 167
text:
"The world you're in is just a game, and I'm a player …"

Elux said. However, he was shocked to find that the content of his words had turned into an incoherent sentence. He did not give up and kept trying. He found that as long as he wanted to reveal any information about the "real world," the system would change his words.

Cyberlos shook his head helplessly. "It's the same as the hypnosis record. Nonsense."

Elux was stunned. Suddenly, he realized that the NPCs would notice the uniqueness of the players. It must have been deliberately simulated by the developers.

"So realistic." Elux was shocked. To be able to give him the illusion that the NPCs were real people, the immersion of Galaxy was off the charts.

He understood the meaning of the name of Galaxy Version 1.0. The developers wanted the players to become 'descenders' and experience the feeling of joining another 'real' world. So, they restricted the players from revealing information about reality to prevent ruining the immersion? He remembered a very old online game where the players from two factions could not chat with each other in the game due to language restrictions. It seemed to be called the World of Divine Beasts.

"That must be it!" Elux was certain.

Even if he felt that the NPCs' curiosity toward the players was simulated, his eyes still lit up. Aside from his identity as a professional player, Elux himself was very interested in Galaxy. He could not wait to know what would happen next. How would the NPCs react when there were more and more players?

The guards brought Elux back. Cyberlos stayed in the laboratory to collect blood from the operating table. After testing, he was no different from a normal person. His eyes flashed as he pondered.

"Elux's phenomenon, let's call it the Inhuman Phenomenon. What is the origin of the Inhuman Phenomenon? Why is it spreading? Most of the Inhumans appeared out of thin air, and there are no records in the database. Could it be that a new race was born? Or is it the effect of some kind of Esper ability? Or is this the projection of a certain advanced civilization? "

Cyberlos turned on the computer and opened a top-secret file. After verifying his fingerprint, iris, and the password that he changed every day, he opened a document. This was a copy of the Treaty of Contact between Universal Civilizations (Seventh Revision). Blue Star had come into contact with the Godora Civilization and obtained a lot of knowledge about the universe. The Germinal Organization also had a copy of this treaty.

It was clearly written that the projection of a Higher Plane entity was an evil means to interfere with the progress of a low-level civilization. The ability to not die was very similar to the description of the projection technology in the treaty. If it was true, then this would be the invasion of an advanced civilization … No, an advanced civilization with physical projection would not need to go through so much trouble to invade. The logical explanation was that Blue Star had become a testing ground for a certain civilization, and if a civilization fell behind, they could only be bullied by others. Cyberlos, on the other hand, was not angry at all. He was excited. The unexpected phenomenon gave him passion.

If the number of Inhumans continued to increase, the Blue Star's situation would change drastically due to the fact that they could not die.

"Inhumans can be brainwashed, and they are highly obedient. However, when asked about the origin of the inhumans, they will talk nonsense. I guess it is an instinctive reaction or an unknown language. More experiments are needed to prove it.

The transmission of the Inhuman Phenomenon was unknown. It was impossible to determine whether it was a physical transmission or a psychic transmission. The physical and mental state of the Inhumans was the same as that of normal humans. The test results were normal. It was impossible to determine the form of the Inhuman Phenomenon. It could be a supernatural ability, a disease, or a genetic mutation.

What was interesting was that the Inhumans had not been observed sleeping. Speculating from the time, disappearing might be the 'sleeping method' of the Inhumans. Some Inhumans had other supernatural abilities, but they were relatively weak. They seemed to have extraordinary potential, but the reason was unknown. There were more special points that needed to be added …

Was the Inhuman Phenomenon long-term or short-term? Would the number of Inhumans stop increasing? Was there a possibility of the wild beasts being infected with the Inhuman Phenomenon? In the long run, the Inhuman Phenomenon has a lot of hidden dangers. We have to find a countermeasure or containment method as soon as possible … "

After writing the conclusion, Cyberlos submitted the report to the leader. The leader's worldview was slightly impacted. Luckily, he had a firm mind. Because of the existence of all kinds of supernatural abilities, even a normal person had a high acceptance rate. He was used to seeing all kinds of supernatural phenomena that could not be explained.

"The Six Nations will notice the Inhumans sooner or later. In front of this phenomenon, the importance of being our enemy will be secondary. The Six Nations will definitely contact the galactic civilizations and ask about the cause of the Inhuman Phenomenon. They won't have time to start a war, so I have time to breathe."

The leader was also very interested in the cause of the Inhuman Phenomenon, but he could not contact the galactic civilizations. However, he found the most important problem, which was that the Inhumans could be brainwashed and were highly obedient!

When the conditions were right, he naturally had an idea.

"This is a natural cannon fodder!"

Andrea was the territory of the Germinal Organization, and they had absolute control. The leader ordered to capture the Inhumans and bring them back for research and brainwashing. Inhumans had also appeared in the other three continents, but unfortunately, their bases had all been removed, and there was no one to capture them. Only then did the leader realize how much of an opportunity the organization had lost. Everything was because of Zero. He gritted his teeth in hatred and even wanted to use the killing weapon, Destiny's Child, to lock onto Zero's position. However, he had not made up his mind to take the risk.

He did not know how the galactic civilizations viewed the Inhuman Phenomenon. Was it rare or common in the universe?

…

There were four novice villages in the Western Continent. The open beta had been open for more than twenty days, and the average level of the players was almost LV 10. Han Xiao planned to add [Energy Training Technique] to the skill list this time. The price was ten thousand experience points and three thousand aquamarine dollars. Without the prerequisite of ten points of affection, some of the players should be able to afford it.

The plane landed in a small stronghold of Fabian in the Western Continent. The weather in the Western Continent was cold, and the first breath that Han Xiao took after he got off the plane made him feel uncomfortable.

In the past ten days, he had created the frame of the Viper mechanical suit, which was an endoskeleton formed by PE-0 nano-muscle fibers. It looked like a thick black bodysuit, and the wrinkles were all muscle lines. Han Xiao tried it on once, and it was very light. He already had the basic enhancement of his physical fitness. For example, when he punched, the fibers in the mechanical suit would produce elastic force as they were stretched and twisted. This elastic force would be condensed in the direction of the punch through the conductive module, increasing the strength of the punch. It was like gaining a new layer of muscles and tendons, and it was more flexible than an endoskeleton. The user could do whatever he wanted.

It was still in the testing stage, and other materials needed to be added to prevent the loss of strength. Han Xiao spent a lot of EXP and used [Advanced Materials Science] to fuse with other basic knowledge to obtain some useful materials.

He had the frame of the mechanical suit, and the most important part was the energy system. The 'Bonfire' mini reactor was an advanced equipment, and he had asked Lei Zhen Yu to buy it. The seller happened to be in the Western Continent, and Han Xiao had chosen to come to the Western Continent to get the goods.

Mechanical suits were a way to increase one's combat power quickly. As long as he could replicate the Viper mechanical suit, his combat power would increase tremendously.

"Let's go to the Novice Village to get the EXP first."

Han Xiao marked the location on the map and passed it to the pilot. At this time, his phone rang, indicating that he had received a message. He opened it and saw that it was a bounty from the Blood Pact Society.

"Black Phantom, this is a bounty from the upper echelons of the Dark Net. Your mission is to sneak into the mansions of a few Maple officials and leave behind a few documents. Someone will meet you in the Western Continent and pass the documents to you. The following is the location of the meeting and the specific information of the Maple officials …"

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and called Bennett directly. "Hey, what are you doing?"

It was good to know the upper echelons. One phone call and he could ask directly. Compared to the other assassins, he was considered to have connections.

"Maple rejected the material aid because these officials are obstructing us," Bennett said. "They are in charge of the financial budget. You know the situation in Maple. It's like touching the little treasury of these officials, and they are against it with all their might."

"What material aid?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. He had a hunch.

"I haven't mentioned it to you yet. The organization is preparing for a large-scale project, codenamed [Sanctuary]. Originally, there was a one-year preparation period, but the war is about to break out, so we can only plan ahead and ask for material aid from various countries. Only Maple rejected it."
